name: ToonCommon_TypeMaskRampMaskFurTangent
kuro_asm: Common PS __64048 (MI_R2T1ZanniMd20011Fur) / VS __64064 (WuwaToonBaseVS_WPO_Fur, round 6 VS port)

A.kuro: o1 GBufferA: xy oct normal, z toon shadow factor, w flag

B.kuro: o2 GBufferB: rgb sqrt(shadow colour), a (LightingChannelMask<<5 | ShadingModelId)/255

C.kuro: o3 GBufferC: rgb lit colour, a MainTex.a*OpacityIntensity / rim byte

D.kuro: o6 "GBufferD": x ToonRimWidth, y packed nibble, z 0, w packed AO|FFT

OpacityMask.kuro: constant 1: the entry discards itself (fur clip + Kuro primitive dither)

PixelDepthOffset.kuro: material pixel depth offset (UseFurry); the Kuro PS writes SV_DepthLessEqual = UE ApplyPixelDepthOffset device depth

input_kinds.texture: Texture2D material parameter `param` (Texture Object pin); `default` = parent Material default texture
input_kinds.sampler: sampler paired with `texture`; ue_expr is the HLSL name inside the Custom node
input_kinds.scalar|vector: material parameter `param` (Kuro name), `default` = compiled/Material default; vector `channels` used
input_kinds.worldnormal|worldtangent: raw interpolated TangentToWorld rows (`channel` sign/bitangent), ue_expr given
input_kinds.interpolator: value produced in the VS by `source` (vertex_interpolators)
input_kinds.cpd: CustomPrimitiveData `index` (list = assembled vector), filled by UWuwaToonCharacterComponent
input_kinds.mpc: Material Parameter Collection `mpc` / `mpc_param` (Kuro asset default in `default`)
input_kinds.toonlight: ToonShadowLightData CB1 row `index` (float4); no recovered default (see note on [1].w bits)
input_kinds.view: View uniform field (ue_expr) or Kuro-only View member (ue_expr null, `kuro` row, explicit default)
input_kinds.primitive: Primitive data (ue_expr) or Kuro-only Primitive member (ue_expr null, explicit default)
input_kinds.output: out parameter, exposed as an additional Custom node output

wpo.note: UseFurry base-pass VS (VS __50707 / __64064) = WuwaToonBaseVS_WPO + the vertex-normal fur shell offset; verified bit-exact on SV_POSITION and TEXCOORD2 with PreViewTranslation = 0 (evidence/validation/shaderdiff/roster_charcom/round6/vs/results_vs.json; research/roster/round6/vs.md). The fur facing term uses the translated camera vector (Kuro: absolute); realistic-camera residual <= 0.0016 px, see the write-up

roster_variant.notes: TypeMaskRampMask body. UseFurry: fur shell clip (Fur_Tex on UV2, view-angle fade, vertex-alpha gate (UseVertexColor), UseTangentClip, opacity saturate(MainTex.a * OpacityIntensity)) with the Kuro primitive dither, and the material pixel depth offset; two passes as the Kuro PS: main chain (precise forms) for emissive / GBufferC.rgb, post-PDO custom-output chain for GBufferA.z / B / C.a / D.
